_note: Master sweep of player jutsu text (player jutsu overhaul, RUL-2026-10-21-021; house style docs/design/jutsu_overhaul/WRITING_STYLE.md; findings docs/reviews/JUTSU_TEXT_SWEEP_2026-10-21.md). Suggest mode: content review desk, no direct save; one suggestion per jutsu, each approved or rejected on its own. Every item changes only description and battleDescription, with injectableInBattle re-sent at its live value (law 20). Records: the 2026-10-21 census (push/178-181), visible player jutsu with no bloodline, not equipped by any AI (push/158-161), no test or staff names, and no open suggestion (push/182-195 and earlier suggest tickets excluded). Staff 'DON'T TRAIN' notes inside descriptions are kept. Names, effects and balance are untouched; name and mechanics findings are listed for the director. Operator runs it from Forge; never skipPreflight.

suggestion.title: Rewrite description and battle line
suggestion.rationale: Text now matches the jutsu's effects.

data.battleDescription: %user vanishes in a smear of afterimages and reappears across the field before anyone can react.

suggestion.rationale: Neither text mentioned the time dilation (the user's actions cost fewer action points for 1 round). Battle line had no full stop.

suggestion.rationale: Battle line was ungrammatical ("forging a spear... and takes shape into"). Description now says the strike pierces defences along a line and gives the user +10% damage for 2 rounds.

data.battleDescription: %user bursts across the battlefield in a streak of violet energy, tearing through nearby enemies and throwing off their rhythm.

suggestion.rationale: Battle line used %target on an empty-ground jutsu. Description trimmed to length; it still covers the move, the hit and the 5% damage reduction on enemies for 2 rounds.

suggestion.rationale: Description spoke of nearby targets and ran to three sentences; the jutsu affects one target. Now states both effects (user +25% damage for 3 rounds, target +25% damage taken for 2).

suggestion.rationale: Description had no full stop, and "rapidly drains" implied an ongoing drain where the health cost is paid upfront. Shield (800 health for 2 rounds) and battle line unchanged.

data.description: A lost oath that splits the sky with dust and yin-yang chakra and crashes down on the target, threatening to seal their elements. Its chains then bind the user, armouring them while every technique costs more for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user draws their weapon across the empty air, and a heartbeat later the sky splits open, crashing down on %target in a silent, dust-white rupture that can seal their elements. As the oath closes, chakra chains lash around %user's arms, hardening them against harm at a steep price in chakra and stamina.

suggestion.rationale: Description omitted the user's damage reduction (-22% for 2 rounds). Battle line ran to six sentences and claimed costs doubled; they rise by 35%. Now: hit, 80% chance to seal elemental 60 AP jutsu for 2 rounds, user tougher but pays more.
